Method of Attack: Allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on the attacked machine using a specially prepared archive file with the RAR extension
Impacted Systems: Systems running WinRAR archiver software, affecting more than half a billion users
Attack Vector: User interaction (opening a malicious RAR archive)
Downloading archives from uncertain sites or emails from unknown recipients
Indicators of Compromise: Opening a RAR archive generated by attackers
Receiving and opening compressed files from untrusted sources
